This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] distinguished by their large, three-toed feet, as well as massive, three-fingered hands. They also possessed long faces with knobbly craniums. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], two members of this species traveled aboard a [[transport]] known as the ''[[Tippler's Groan]]'' headed from [[Darsie]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Phorliss]] alongside the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]].<ref name="MJ4" />

{{Species-stub}}
